DJ Cummerbund is an American mashup artist, DJ, and producer from Long Island, New York.
Since 2014, he has released mashup songs that have attracted mainstream media attention, praise from musicians he's sampled, and hundreds of millions of views online.
He is a recipient of a Webby Award and an MTV Video Music Award, and has performed as an opening act for the B-52s during their farewell tour and Las Vegas residencies.
